guardIncident.finding: During the update-persistence step the health guard reported screen=true (safe=false). The user removed the daemon Screen Recording grant; after daemon restart the guard returned safe=true. Root cause of stale display: health used a sync.Once-cached guard; fixed to use ComputerTCCBoundaryCheck() (fresh passive check per health call). Fix deployed and verified (PID 75517, safe=true).
guardIncident.lesson: The DAEMON_COMPUTER_TCC_MUST_BE_NONE guard itself detected a real dangerous configuration (user-granted Screen) during the gate — proving the fail-closed design works.
